decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-7e3267b542c5] and the upgrade-guide section [ev-a3db376e8800] state the subject (CEL expressions in the Telemetry API) and the exact rename mapping: peer metadata is now stored in filter_state.downstream_peer/upstream_peer "instead of" filter_state["wasm.downstream_peer"]/["wasm.upstream_peer"], node metadata in xds.node instead of node, and Wasm attributes must be fully qualified. They also give has() as the backwards-compatible form for mixed proxies. That is enough to write the consequence: on 1.24 proxies, unchanged expressions that use the old paths no longer find the peer or node metadata, which is why the guide offers the has() fallback. Neither source says exactly how this fails (empty value or evaluation error), and [ev-4ca241aa627b] shows the same rename applied to filterStateObjectsToLog, so my confidence is low.
